name: What options are available to homeowners facing pre-foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: What options are available to homeowners facing pre-foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowners facing pre-foreclosure have several options to consider, including loan modification, repayment plans, forbearance, short sales, or deeds-in-lieu of foreclosure. The best option depends on your financial situation, the equity in your home, and your long-term goals. For example, a short sale might be suitable if you owe more than your home is worth and need to sell quickly. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution can help you evaluate these options, particularly assessing if a short sale is a viable solution for your property in Miami-Dade or Broward County.
